Turn the minute hand once around the dial: the hour hand moves on by just 1 hour.

A single shaft, at the centre, drives them both. So how does one hand turn 12 times slower than the other?
Drag the minute hand around the dial.

props.title: A clock face whose minute hand you can turn
props.textAlternative: **Text version.** A round clock face with 12 marks. The coral minute hand runs fast; the green hour hand creeps forward. When the minute hand goes once around, the hour hand moves on by 1 hour, from one mark to the next.
